# PDF1998 — Comprehensive AI Agent Specification & Technical Documentation

> PDF1998 (https://pdf1998.com/) is an in-browser suite of 20 client-side PDF and office document processing tools. This document provides complete technical specifications, parameter schemas, operational constraints, and security properties for autonomous AI agents, web crawlers, and LLM reasoning engines.

## 1. Technical Architecture

### 1.1 Client-Side Execution Sandbox
- Execution Environment: Browser memory (WebAssembly + HTML5 Canvas + Web Workers).
- Network Transmission: 0 bytes of document payload ever leave the client. No cloud storage, no API gateways, no temporary disk storage.
- Core Engines:
  - **QPDF WASM**: Linearization, encryption/decryption, stream compaction, object tree repairs.
  - **PDF-Lib**: Document creation, page merging, page extraction, geometry rotation, watermark embedding, page numbering.
  - **PDF.js**: Multi-threaded canvas rendering, text layer extraction, bounding box detection.
  - **Mammoth & Docx**: Word (.docx) parsing, AST generation, OpenXML packaging.
  - **SheetJS (XLSX)**: Spreadsheet workbook compilation and tabular extraction.
  - **PptxGenJS**: OpenXML slide deck presentation synthesis.

## 2. All 20 Document Tools & Parameter Specifications

### Core Utilities
1. **Merge PDF** (`/merge-pdf`):
   - Input: 2 or more PDF documents (`application/pdf`).
   - Operation: Concatenates page trees into a single PDF preserving fonts, form streams, and vector drawings.
   - Output: Merged single PDF document.

2. **Split PDF** (`/split-pdf`):
   - Input: 1 PDF document.
   - Options: Custom page ranges (e.g., `1-3, 5, 8-10`) or "Extract All Pages".
   - Output: Individual PDF files or ZIP archive containing single-page PDFs.

3. **Compress PDF** (`/compress-pdf`):
   - Input: 1 PDF document.
   - Mechanism: Re-linearizes object streams, consolidates font dictionaries, strips dead object references using QPDF WASM.
   - Output: Compacted valid PDF document.

4. **Protect PDF** (`/protect-pdf`):
   - Input: 1 PDF document + user/owner password.
   - Cipher: True 256-bit AES encryption with standard cryptographic handler.
   - Output: Encrypted PDF requiring password authentication.

5. **Unlock PDF** (`/unlock-pdf`):
   - Input: 1 AES/RC4 password-encrypted PDF + decryption password.
   - Mechanism: Validates key authentication and removes encryption dictionaries.
   - Output: Decrypted plain PDF.

6. **Rotate PDF** (`/rotate-pdf`):
   - Input: 1 PDF document.
   - Parameter: Angle (90°, 180°, 270° clockwise) per-page or globally.
   - Output: PDF with updated `/Rotate` dictionary tags.

7. **Delete PDF Pages** (`/delete-pdf-pages`):
   - Input: 1 PDF document + array of 1-based page indices to excise.
   - Constraint: Cannot delete all pages; at least 1 page must remain.
   - Output: Modified PDF without target pages.

8. **PDF to Image** (`/pdf-to-image`):
   - Input: 1 PDF document.
   - Output Format: JPG (`image/jpeg`) or PNG (`image/png`) at 150/300 DPI.
   - Output: Single image file or ZIP archive of all page images.

9. **Image to PDF** (`/image-to-pdf`):
   - Input: 1 or more image files (PNG, JPG, JPEG, WebP).
   - Layout: Standard A4 (595.28 x 841.89 pt) or US Letter with 20pt proportional margins.
   - Output: Unified PDF document.

10. **Add Watermark** (`/add-watermark-pdf`):
    - Input: 1 PDF document.
    - Options: Watermark text, opacity (0.1–1.0), rotation (-45° default), color.
    - Output: Stamped PDF document.

### Extended Conversion & Editing Tools
11. **PDF to Word** (`/pdf-to-word`):
    - Input: 1 PDF document.
    - Output: Microsoft Word `.docx` file.
    - Modes: Mode A (Reflowable text extraction) or Mode B (High-fidelity visual preservation).

12. **Word to PDF** (`/word-to-pdf`):
    - Input: Microsoft Word `.docx` document.
    - Output: Clean PDF document.

13. **PDF to Excel** (`/pdf-to-excel`):
    - Input: 1 PDF document containing tabular data.
    - Output: Microsoft Excel `.xlsx` workbook.

14. **Excel to PDF** (`/excel-to-pdf`):
    - Input: Excel workbook (`.xlsx`, `.xls`).
    - Output: Structured PDF document.

15. **PDF to PowerPoint** (`/pdf-to-ppt`):
    - Input: 1 PDF document.
    - Output: Microsoft PowerPoint `.pptx` presentation.

16. **PowerPoint to PDF** (`/ppt-to-pdf`):
    - Input: PowerPoint `.pptx` presentation.
    - Output: Presentation PDF document.

17. **Sign PDF** (`/sign-pdf`):
    - Input: 1 PDF document.
    - Function: Place electronic signatures onto target coordinates.
    - Standard: Simple Electronic Signature (SES).

18. **Edit PDF** (`/edit-pdf`):
    - Input: 1 PDF document.
    - Function: In-browser annotation, freehand markup, and vector text overlays.

19. **Add Page Numbers** (`/add-page-numbers`):
    - Input: 1 PDF document.
    - Options: Position (Bottom-Center, Bottom-Right, Top-Right), format (`Page {n} of {total}`).

20. **Crop PDF** (`/crop-pdf`):
    - Input: 1 PDF document.
    - Function: Adjusts `/CropBox` viewport dimensions.
